misc: Adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season
biography: Simo, representing Hirsala Golf, is preparing for his eleventh foray into the prestigious Hector Trophée. His consistent presence across more than a decade of this esteemed pairs competition underscores a deep-seated passion for the game and an unwavering commitment to its challenges.

Over his ten previous appearances, Simo has proven to be a highly effective collaborator, a key contributor to his pairs earning the esteemed Hector Trophée on three separate occasions. This remarkable record establishes him as one of the tournament's most successful team players. While the individual Victor Trophy has yet to grace his mantelpiece, his role in team successes has been consistently significant.

Known for his forthright demeanor, Simo approaches the course with an unbridled intensity that is often punctuated by passionate exclamations, reflecting his competitive spirit. Always seeking an edge, he embraced a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season, a strategic adjustment designed to fine-tune his performance on the greens and further enhance his scoring potential.

As Simo steps onto the tee for the Hector Trophée 2026, the golf community anticipates whether this seasoned competitor, celebrated for his team victories and evolving technique, can channel his fiery determination towards claiming his first individual accolade, adding another dimension to his already impressive tournament legacy.
